raw_segments.text: I will ordake thee, Cleopatra, and weep for my pardon.
So it must be, for now all length is torture, since the torch is out, lie down, and stray
Now all labor marrs what it does, yea, very force entangles itself with strength.
Seal then, and all is done.
Where souls do couch on flowers, will hand in hand, and with our sprightly port make
Dido and her Aeneas shall want troops, and all the hauntbiorrs.
